impact: A calm open into a heavy catalyst week. Nvidia's report Tuesday after the close is the swing factor for MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS and the AI power trade (BE); a soft guide would hit the whole AI complex.
summary: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 0.4-0.6% and S&P 500 futures 0.1-0.3% Sunday evening, with Dow futures near flat, as traders braced for Nvidia earnings Tuesday, Fed minutes Wednesday and the Anthropic IPO later in the week. All three indexes gained over 2% last week, their best week since August, even as Nvidia fell 13%.
title: US futures tick higher Sunday night, Nasdaq futures up about 0.4%
